description: What the Phase 4 suite must notice in the reader of a SKILL.md front matter (lib/plugins.mjs: the block scalar header, its text, the message that names the skill and the key) and in the opt-in manifest check (tests/live/check-skill-manifests.mjs).

mutations.name: Y1-header-start-anchor
mutations.what: the header is not anchored at its start: `>>` is read as `>`

mutations.name: Y2-header-end-anchor
mutations.what: the header is not anchored at its end: `|x` is read as `|`

mutations.name: Y3-indicator-zero
mutations.what: 0 is accepted as an indentation indicator in front of the chomping sign

mutations.name: Y4-indicator-zero-after-sign
mutations.what: 0 is accepted as an indentation indicator behind the chomping sign

mutations.name: Y5-sign-first-order-dropped
mutations.what: the order sign then digit is no longer read: `|-` and `|-2` are refused

mutations.name: Y6-digit-first-order-dropped
mutations.what: the order digit then sign is no longer read: `|2` and `>2-` are refused

mutations.name: Y7-sign-after-digit-dropped
mutations.what: a sign behind the digit is no longer read: `>2-` is refused

mutations.name: Y8-several-signs
mutations.what: any number of signs is accepted behind the digit: `|2--`

mutations.name: Y9-folded-not-a-header
mutations.what: a value that starts with > is not looked at as a header any more

mutations.name: Y10-header-after-unquoting
mutations.what: the header is judged after scalar() unquoted the value: a quoted "|-" becomes a header

mutations.name: Y11-comment-after-header
mutations.what: a comment behind the header is not cut off: `|- # note` is refused

mutations.name: Y12-keep-ignored
mutations.what: + keeps nothing: the final line breaks are dropped

mutations.name: Y13-keep-always
mutations.what: every block keeps its final line breaks

mutations.name: Y14-keep-without-last-break
mutations.what: keep gives the blank lines but not the break of the last line of text

mutations.name: Y15-keep-empty-block
mutations.what: keep adds a line break to a block that has no text

mutations.name: Y16-trailing-blank-lines-kept
mutations.what: the blank lines at the end of a block stay in the text of strip and clip

mutations.name: Y17-folded-and-literal-swapped
mutations.what: > joins with newlines and | collapses to one line

mutations.name: Y18-literal-trimmed
mutations.what: a literal block is trimmed again: its leading blank line and the spaces of its first line are lost

mutations.name: Y19-indicator-ignored
mutations.what: the indentation indicator is read but the column is taken from the first line

mutations.name: Y20-stray-space
mutations.what: the text is cut one character in again, whatever the indent: an inner line keeps a stray space

mutations.name: Y21-shallow-line-accepted
mutations.what: a line less indented than the first line of the text still belongs to the block

mutations.name: Y22-column-read-again
mutations.what: the column is read from every line instead of the first

mutations.name: Y23-tab-allowed
mutations.what: a tab in the indentation is no longer refused

mutations.name: Y24-error-names-no-key
mutations.what: an error names a key only when the call says which one: a bad quote or list item names none

mutations.name: Y25-line-without-key-names-one
mutations.what: a line that is not key: value names the key before it

mutations.name: Y26-duplicate-names-previous-key
mutations.what: a key given twice names the key before it, not itself

mutations.name: Y27-label-is-the-file
mutations.what: the skill is named by the file (SKILL.md), not by its folder

mutations.name: Y28-name-before-folder
mutations.what: the name written in the file wins over the folder

mutations.name: Y29-label-not-cleaned
mutations.what: the label keeps any character, a line break included

mutations.name: Y30-label-not-cut
mutations.what: the label has no length limit

mutations.name: Y31-name-line-unused
mutations.what: the name: line of the file is never used to name the skill

mutations.name: Y32-lines-of-the-trimmed-text
mutations.what: the line number ignores the blank lines that trim() took off in front of the first ---

mutations.name: L1-encoding-not-checked
mutations.what: the live check no longer looks at the encoding of a SKILL.md

patches.old: if (text.includes(REPLACEMENT)) return { ...base, status: 'not_utf8', detail: 'SKILL.md is not valid UTF-8' };

mutations.name: L2-too-large-is-a-download-failure
mutations.what: the live check reports a file over the limit as a failed download

mutations.name: L3-exit-code-always-0
mutations.what: the live check exits 0 although a SKILL.md cannot be read

mutations.name: L4-listing-failure-ignored
mutations.what: a catalog that could not be listed is reported as an empty one that passes

mutations.name: L5-readable-skills-always-listed
mutations.what: the live check lists every skill, not only the ones it cannot read

mutations.name: L6-unknown-catalog-accepted
mutations.what: an unknown catalog name is not refused up front

mutations.name: L7-size-recheck
mutations.equivalent: The transport already refuses a larger file (the stand-in does as safeFetchSkillBytes does); this line repeats the re-check that Install makes after the download.
mutations.what: the live check no longer re-checks the size of the bytes it got
